cards.text: Judah's King Ahaziah has just been put to death (2 Chronicles 22:9). When his mother, Athaliah, sees that her son is dead, she sets out to annihilate all the royal heirs of the house of Judah. This one is heavy, friend.
But one woman makes a move. Jehoshabeath, King Jehoram's daughter, steals Ahaziah's son Joash away from among the king's sons who are being murdered, and puts him and his nurse in a bedroom.

cards.question: Jehoshabeath hides little Joash so Athaliah can't kill him. Who is Jehoshabeath to Joash's father, Ahaziah?

cards.text: And here's the kicker: Jehoshabeath is also the wife of Jehoiada the priest.

cards.question: Jehoshabeath is the wife of Jehoiada the priest. Where does Joash stay hidden with them?
Joash stays hidden in the house of God for ___ years while Athaliah rules the land.

cards.text: Six years of hiding the king's son in the house of God, friend, and I can't keep a fresh batch hidden from the bakers for six MINUTES. Then in the seventh year, Jehoiada strengthens himself and makes a covenant with five commanders of hundreds.

cards.question: Jehoiada is a priest, and Joash is hidden in the house of God. After the covenant, they go all through Judah and gather the ___ from every city, along with the heads of Israel's families.

cards.text: They come to Jerusalem, and the whole assembly makes a covenant with the king in the house of God. Then Jehoiada speaks: “Behold, the king’s son!”

cards.question: Jehoiada says the king's son must reign. Why?

answers.text: The LORD promised it to David's line
He was born in the house of God
Athaliah once named him her heir

cards.text: Then Jehoiada lays out the plan. A third of the priests and Levites coming on duty on the Sabbath will keep watch at the doors, a third will be at the royal palace and a third at the Foundation Gate, and everyone else will be in the courtyards of the house of the LORD.

cards.question: Jehoiada says only the priests and the Levites who serve may enter the house of the LORD.

cards.text: The Levites must surround the king with weapons in hand and stay close to him wherever he goes. Anyone who enters the temple must be put to death.

cards.question: Jehoiada lets the men going off duty on the Sabbath head home.
From the house of God, Jehoiada hands the commanders spears and shields that belonged to King ___.

cards.text: Jehoiada stations the troops all around the king, by the altar and the temple, from the south side to the north. Then he and his sons bring out the king's son.

cards.question: Jehoiada and his sons bring out the king's son. What do they put on him?

cards.text: They present him with the Testimony, proclaim him king, anoint him and shout, “Long live the king!” From a hidden bedroom to a CROWN, friend, and I thought getting called out of a junk drawer by an angel was a comeback.
Athaliah hears the noise of the people running and cheering the king. So she goes out to them in the house of the LORD.

She looks and sees the king standing by his pillar at the entrance, with officers and trumpeters beside him. All the people of the land are rejoicing and blowing trumpets, and singers are leading the praises.

cards.question: Athaliah sees the new king and the whole crowd celebrating. What does she do?

answers.text: Bows down before the new king

cards.text: She screams, “Treason, treason!” Then Jehoiada sends out the commanders: “Bring her out between the ranks, and put to the sword anyone who follows her.”

cards.question: Jehoiada wants Athaliah put to death right there in the house of the LORD.

cards.text: They seize Athaliah as she reaches the entrance of the Horse Gate on the palace grounds, and there they put her to death.

cards.question: Jehoiada makes a covenant between himself, the king and the people that they will be the LORD's people.
After the covenant, all the people go to the temple of Baal, a false god. What do they do to it?

cards.text: The people smash the altars and idols to pieces and kill Mattan, the priest of Baal, in front of the altars.

cards.question: Jehoiada puts someone in charge of the house of the LORD. Who?

cards.text: These are the priests David appointed, there to offer burnt offerings to the LORD as written in the Law of Moses, with rejoicing and song. I hum to my oven every morning, and friend, even the OVEN has asked me to keep it down.

cards.question: Jehoiada leaves the gates of the house of the LORD open to anyone at all.

cards.text: Then Jehoiada takes the commanders, the nobles, the rulers and all the people of the land, and they bring the king down from the house of the LORD and into the royal palace through the Upper Gate. Joash gets a parade, and when an angel called me out of my junk drawer, the rubber band next to me SLEPT through it.

cards.question: Inside the palace, they seat King Joash on the royal ___.
All the people of the land rejoice, and the city is ___.

cards.text: The city is quiet because Athaliah has been put to the sword. But hang on, friend, because Joash's story is just getting started.
